title: A resolution is a bound, and none is below zero
note: AUD-056. A stated resolution below zero turned the interval a verdict holds a value to inside out, so a value supported what it contradicts. The research ledger's reader of outputs leaves such an output out (NB1); research.holds_an_interval states what bounds an interval (NB2), and the evaluation (NB3) and the claim check (NB4) decide nothing on a value that does not; the second reader restates the rule in its verdict (NB5). tests/test_resolution_bound.py holds each.

mutations.name: NB2_an_interval_turned_inside_out_holds_a_value
mutations.rationale: a resolution below zero is taken to bound an interval, and the evaluation and the claim check decide on it
